statements.impact_statement: msgpack 1.1.2 is not installed. It is only listed in the SBOM files that pip (pip/_vendor/bom.cdx.json) and virtualenv (embedded pip wheels) ship. pip vendors msgpack's pure-Python fallback without the C extension, where the crash lives, and never reuses a streaming decoder after an error. pip >= 26.3 vendors msgpack 1.2.1; drop this statement once the image carries it.

setuptools 70.3.0 is not installed. It is only listed in the SBOM files that pip (pip/_vendor/bom.cdx.json) and virtualenv (embedded pip wheels) ship, because pip vendors pkg_resources from it. setuptools.package_index, where the path traversal lives, is not part of pip. The installed setuptools is current.

setuptools 70.3.0 is not installed. It is only listed in the SBOM files that pip and virtualenv ship, because pip vendors pkg_resources from it. The sdist / MANIFEST.in code is not part of pip, and the issue needs a macOS APFS/HFS+ filesystem, not the image's Linux one.

setuptools 82.0.1 is not installed. It is a seed wheel embedded in virtualenv (pre-commit's dependency) and only used for Python 3.9 environments, which the image does not provide. The issue also needs a macOS APFS/HFS+ filesystem, not the image's Linux one.
